title: Jason Licht: If we were playing in a couple weeks, Bucky Irving would be ready

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jason Licht: If we were playing in a couple weeks, Bucky Irving would be ready
sources.description: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles raised some concern about running back Bucky Irving's fitness when he said he thinks Irving will be ready to return from a shoulder injury in the "summer or fall," but a couple of developments in June have painted a better picture.
